purpose: Candidate search labels only; do not treat these descriptions as recovered historical implementations or as a formal experiment protocol.

variants.full: Reuse ExpertExactD2Pred frozen predictions; never retrain Full.
variants.no_wiener: Remove Wiener, retain STL, then recompute DWC, EDC, and AEP tokens.
variants.no_stl: Remove STL, retain Wiener, then recompute DWC, EDC, and AEP tokens.
variants.no_adaptive_trend_fusion: Replace learned Wiener/STL fusion with fixed equal weighting; recompute EDC and AEP tokens.
variants.no_dwc: Remove DWC prediction branch and all DWC-conditioned event attention; retain trend only to define EDC.
variants.no_edc: Remove EDC prediction branch, event encoder, and AEP tokens; retain DWC branch.
variants.di_only: Single raw causal DI encoder and RUL head; no decomposition, AEP, or dual-branch fusion.
variants.no_cross_branch_fusion: Retain both branches and replace learned cross-branch fusion with arithmetic mean of independently trained branch RUL outputs.
variants.no_aep: Retain EDC descriptors and event encoder; replace adaptive partitioning with fixed uniform segmentation under the registered token budget.
